description: A bare null key in a static map is the string null
notes: The spec makes a bare identifier key a literal name, but in expressions null is the keyword for a null value, and a keyword's role supersedes other interpretations. A static map doesn't convert keys to strings, so the two readings give the string "null" or a null value. hashicorp/hcl gives the string: ObjectConsKeyExpr.Value names the key with hcl.ExprAsKeyword, and LiteralValueExpr.AsTraversal turns the null literal back into its name (hclsyntax/expression.go).
